content.text: Included in an exclusive group of players under the age of 23 who netted 10 or more goals in Europe's top five leagues, he stands alongside talents such as Benjamin Sesko from RB Leipzig, Bradley Barcola of Paris St-Germain, and Hugo Ekitike representing Eintracht Frankfurt.
Following their fifth-place finish in the Premier League last season, Newcastle is looking to bolster their attacking options in anticipation of their return to the Champions League.
Ekitike has caught the attention of the Reds, but any potential deal could be influenced by the asking price and the circumstances surrounding 25-year-old Swedish striker Alexander Isak at Newcastle.
